en.headline: Education Bureau rejects claim it refused extra mental-health staff
en.dek: The bureau said social-media posts that it had refused to send more on-site support were unfounded, and that extra resources would be added if needed.
body: The Education Bureau said on Saturday that social-media and parent-group posts claiming it had refused to send extra on-site staff to support students’ mental health had no basis in fact, and asked the public not to share them.

In a statement, the bureau said it was saddened by student deaths by suicide and that each case can involve many factors. It said the priority is early identification and support. It also said some online reports had taken remarks out of context and that such claims could harm students who need help.

The bureau said school-based teams of educational psychologists, counsellors and social workers already work with students, and that teachers refer pupils who show distress. It said a three-tier emergency mechanism used in secondary schools is being made standing from 1 December 2025 and is being tried in Primary Four to Six.

Officials said they would watch how pupils settle into the new school year and would add resources and staff if needed. October to January has been designated a mental-health period for schools under a bureau programme. The bureau urged parents who are worried about a child to seek professional help.

zh.headline: 教育局：拒增派到校支援人手說法並無根據
zh.dek: 教育局周六發文，指社交平台及家長群組流傳局方拒絕增派人手處理學童精神健康的說法全無事實根據，有需要時會增撥資源。
body: 教育局周六表示，近日社交媒體及家長群組流傳局方「拒增派到校支援人手」處理學童精神健康，有關說法全無事實根據，呼籲公眾不要誤信及轉發。
局方對學生輕生感到難過，指每宗事件背後可能涉及情緒、家庭、校園生活及人際關係等多方面因素，最重要是及早識別、關心和支援。局方並對部分網上報道斷章取義表示遺憾，認為不實說法無助處理問題，更可能對有需要的學生造成負面影響。
教育局指，校內已有校本教育心理學家、輔導人員及學校社工等跨專業團隊；教師發現學生情緒困擾會轉介專業跟進。局方稱，中學「三層應急機制」將由2025年12月1日起恆常化，並試行擴展至小四至小六。
局方表示會密切留意新學年適應情況，有需要時必會增撥資源與人手。10月至明年1月定為「4Rs精神健康月」，鼓勵學校舉辦相關活動。局方呼籲家長若發現子女情緒受困，應尋求專業協助。
